# NSTool

`nstool.exe` is the unmodified Windows x64 executable from [NSTool v1.9.2](https://github.com/jakcron/nstool/releases/tag/v1.9.2), by Jack (jakcron).

- Release archive: `nstool-v1.9.2-win_x64.zip`
- Archive SHA-256: `34659dc47249a3c00f7fc88a11f4e5ba14dfbec0a6a96b4f3f71368a7e1c9374`
- Executable SHA-256: `844648190dd8688098887a369da1126c1b3ab1c2a664fb603b01cb22e76b6ca9`

These hashes were calculated from the downloaded release; upstream did not publish a checksum for independent verification.
The `licenses/` directory contains NSTool's MIT license and notices for the dependencies pinned by that release:
libfmt (`b03b081`), liblz4 (`561775a`), libmbedtls (`7434637`), libpietendo (`5d50d02`), and libtoolchain (`578d170`).
